A_fit_then_heavy.exercise: Previously active, followed by prolonged inactivity

B_heavy_then_recovery.exercise: Previously inactive; consistent exercise and walking have gradually resumed
B_heavy_then_recovery.diet: Improved regular meals and reduced excess energy intake

personality: Confident and proud, with an appealing expression

species.mongle: Soft, warm, fluffy creature. Preserve the actual reference's wool, colors, face and distinctive motifs; athletic forms may become agile or protective.
species.tori: Nature creature with vegetation and leaf motifs. Preserve the actual reference's plant structures, coloring and lineage; mature forms may become a balanced nature guardian.
species.lucan: Powerful quadrupedal beast. In this pack it has charcoal fur, amber-gold eyes, a pale cheek and chest ruff, pointed ears, and gold-edged dark plates and accents. Preserve these visible lineage motifs.

form_prompts.FIT: Regular exercise and appropriate meals: athletic species-appropriate proportions, energetic carriage and a clear mature silhouette.
form_prompts.BALANCED: Moderate everyday activity and balanced meals: healthy, proportionate anatomy. Walking alone must never produce obesity.
form_prompts.INACTIVE: Low activity without established sustained energy excess: quieter posture and possible mild softness. Do not automatically make the creature obese.
form_prompts.HEAVY: Prolonged low activity AND sustained energy surplus: clearly increased BODY FAT, a round protruding abdomen, broader waist, softer flanks and an appreciably heavier silhouette. Keep a commanding, attractive, strong guardian presence. Additional muscle, thicker armor or global scale alone is insufficient.
form_prompts.RECOVERY: A previously heavy or inactive creature after consistent exercise and improved meals: gradual recovery, some retained softness, better posture and endurance. Do not instantly transform into an extreme athlete.

form_mapping_note: The archive describes narrative paths rather than a machine-readable stage/form table. These four-stage defaults are explicit implementation interpretations of the visible sequence, editable independently from stage.
